name: Soufiane, Tacsou
summary: Morocco-based developer focused on memorable, challenging 2D games.
paragraphs: I’m Soufiane, a software developer and indie game developer based in Morocco. I have been passionate about video games since I was a kid and have been playing them ever since. With a focus on 2D, I strive to create unique and memorable gaming experiences that offer both fun and challenges for players.
